coordination.qwen_reliability_current_narrow_work: canonical operationCandidates/preferred account cooldown and thread affinity
coordination.relationship_to_prior_integration_work: This is the next required layer after the already-recorded store-wide lost-update/claim-race fix. Store-wide serialization alone is insufficient unless status transitions also validate their expected predecessor atomically.

observed_product_semantics: src/subagent-batch-store.js updateTask() blindly merges patch into the current task record and has no expected-status guard.
markRunning/markDone/markFailed/markUncertain are unconditional wrappers around that blind update.
src/subagent-agent-runner.js performs model/tool work outside the store transaction and later calls markDone/markFailed/markUncertain.
Therefore a slower stale executor can finish after another executor has durably committed done and overwrite done with uncertain/failed, or a later markRunning can reopen a terminal task.
required_fix_contract: The whole batch-store read -> validate expected predecessor status -> mutate -> atomic replace must be under the same interprocess serialization/CAS boundary already required by the global lost-update finding.
Terminal completion transitions done/failed/uncertain must accept only the exact expected predecessor for that execution attempt, normally running.

markRunning must atomically compare against the status observed/authorized by the runner; explicit retryUncertain may authorize running/uncertain recovery, but an unrelated stale caller may not reopen a newer terminal state.
A stale transition must fail closed with a dedicated non-secret error such as QWEN_SUBAGENT_BATCH_STALE_TRANSITION and must not rewrite the store.
Regression must cover two writers where winner commits done and loser later attempts uncertain/failed; final durable state must remain done and preserve the winner result.
Regression must also cover explicit authorized retry path without weakening terminal-state monotonicity.
important_note: A status guard implemented outside the store-wide lock is not sufficient: two processes can still both validate the same old state. This fix must land together with or on top of interprocess serialization/CAS.
